lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits, with inter-centroid spacing increasing toward the posterior region of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the circular blobs, forming a geometric grid of high-contrast anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-luminance dorsal pixels to shadowed ventral pixels.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density population of small high-luminance blobs that are significantly smaller in diameter than the blobs on the primary lateral flank.
